svg.text: 5 Key Assumed Parameters with Pessimistic / Optimistic Case Impact on System Metrics
ASSUMED: ADC unit area (A_adc) = 150 µm² (4-bit SAR ADC + TIA (28nm published scaling))
Pessimistic [250 µm² (+67%)]: Tile area: 4,736 µm² (+44%); Chip: 2.01 mm² (+42%)
Optimistic [80 µm² (−47%)]: Tile area: 1,736 µm² (−47%); Chip: 0.76 mm² (−46%)
ASSUMED: ADC energy per conversion (E_adc) = 0.5 pJ/conv (4-bit SAR ADC at 25 MHz (28nm literature))
Pessimistic [2.0 pJ/conv (+300%)]: Total energy: 86.4 nJ/token (+197%); active power: 86.7 mW (+198%)
Optimistic [0.1 pJ/conv (−80%)]: Total energy: 15.2 nJ/token (−48%); active power: 15.3 mW (−47%)
ASSUMED: Junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (θ_ja) = 200 °C/W (Bare die on PCB, natural convection)
Pessimistic [500 °C/W]: T_j = 39.7°C (+8.8°C) — still safe, but tighter
ASSUMED: Memristor Arrhenius activation energy (E_a) = 0.6 eV (HfO₂ memristor retention (literature))
Pessimistic [0.3 eV (low-E_a device)]: Drift acceleration at 70°C: 6.8× → shorter refresh interval required
Optimistic [0.9 eV (stable device)]: Drift acceleration at 70°C: 2.0× → longer calibration interval feasible
ASSUMED: Digital baseline energy (GEMV reference) = 250 nJ/token (8-bit int8 systolic GEMV at 28nm (assumed))
Pessimistic [80 nJ/token (optimized GPU kernel)]: Efficiency advantage: 2.7× (vs 8.6× baseline)
Optimistic [500 nJ/token (FP16 baseline)]: Efficiency advantage: 17.2× (vs 8.6× baseline)
